summary: Build practical ISO 13485 MDQMS implementation skills with PECB training, case-study exercises, and preparation for the Lead Implementer exam.
audienceIntro: ISO 13485 Lead Implementer training is for professionals who establish, operate, advise on, or assess a medical-device quality management system. It is particularly relevant when your work involves turning ISO 13485 requirements into documented processes and supporting conformance across the MDQMS.
prerequisites: PECB lists a fundamental understanding of ISO 13485 and comprehensive knowledge of implementation principles as prerequisites for the training course. To apply for the PECB Certified ISO 13485 Lead Implementer credential, you need to pass the Lead Implementer exam or an equivalent exam, have five years of professional experience including two years in Medical Devices Quality Management, document 300 hours of MDQMS project activities, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics.
